input.answer: If I have to pick, I'd take the second one, "ב. רשימה אחת מהזול ליקר", because the first one opens with long lists of "S&P 500" and shares and I got lost in it. But to be honest, neither one showed me anything as safe as my deposit, and I never reached the third option. I'll ask you or the bank before I touch anything.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the big title and three dense bullet lines
stuck.why: The page says 'שלוש אפשרויות' and 'קופת גמל להשקעה: 143 מסלולים של 12 חברות'. I couldn't tell if this was about safe saving at all. The bullets were long lines and I lost them in the middle.

The first group is 'עוקב מדד s&p 500' in English letters, then 'מניות', then 'עוקב מדדי מניות'. That's four screens of shares and nothing about bonds or anything safe. I almost stopped here, it felt like it wasn't for me.
There are about twenty little buttons. 'אג"ח ממשלתי סחיר 1' and 'כספי (שקלי) 10' caught my eye, but I didn't dare press them and didn't know what they would show.
The rows are mixed. Some say 'אשראי ואג"ח' and have low share numbers, others are S&P again. I couldn't tell which one is 'safe'.
